title: Spending app with CSV uploads, budgets and an Ask agent
prompt: I want an app to understand my spending. I upload bank statements as CSV files (date, description, amount) and they build up over time. Statements can overlap, so the same transaction must never count twice. AI puts each new transaction in a category from my list, which I can add to, rename or delete. Renaming updates everything in that category. Deleting sends its transactions to Uncategorized. If I change a transaction's category by hand, that sticks, and the app offers to apply it to other transactions from that merchant, but never overwrites ones I set by hand. I can set a monthly budget per category. A dashboard shows spending by month and category and warns me about categories over budget in the selected month. Refunds reduce a category's spend. All of it exact to the cent. An Ask page lets me ask things like 'how much did I spend on groceries in March compared to February?' An AI agent answers by calculating from my current data, including my edits, and shows the numbers it used. If an upload has a bad row, skip it, tell me which row and keep the rest. Save everything between visits. My Anthropic key is set up. Make it and get it working.
